subject: Scaling verification and onboarding evidence — load run & next steps
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@calyxhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Calyx onboarding — initial throughput target and test window

Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move the onboarding forward and lock a short window for an official load run. A few quick items from our side: 
- Target throughput: ~3k tokens/sec sustained for our common usage pattern (peak bursts to 5k for 90s)
- 95th pct latency target: < 450ms for requests under 1k tokens
- Test window: any day during Apr 7–9 (our infra team will be on call)

Can Redwood confirm this target is achievable on your Dedicated config (g4dn-like) and share a recommended run plan? If you can also send a short checklist we can run pre-checks on our side to avoid noisy failures.

— Liam
Infra Lead, Calyx Health
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@calyxhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Calyx onboarding — initial throughput target and test window

Hi Liam — great to hear you want to schedule the formal run. Short answers up front: the targets look reasonable and we can aim to validate them in a targeted 3-hour window. I've attached a concise run plan (calyx_loadplan_v1.pdf) and the Redwood runbook we will follow. Key notes:

- Redwood config: Dedicated pool (3x p3-equivalent nodes) with prefix KV caching enabled for frequent prompts. We will throttle bursts with staged ramping to reproduce the 5k peak.
- Acceptance criteria we will verify: sustained throughput >= 3000 tokens/sec for 10 continuous minutes at steady state; 95th latency < 450ms for payloads under 1k tokens; error rate < 0.5%.
- Pre-checks for Calyx: open whitelisted IPs for the test CIDR, ensure request signing key is present, and a representative sample of prompt templates (please upload to the Drive link).
- Run schedule suggestion: Apr 8, 10:00–13:00 PT. Our SRE (Monica) and product lead (Marcus) will join.

Attachment: calyx_loadplan_v1.pdf (short plan, scripts to run, and expected metric dashboards).

If that works I will lock the time and circulate the run command and the Grafana dashboard links.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@calyxhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Calyx onboarding — initial throughput target and test window

Quick operational checklist from Redwood side:
- Canary traffic policy enabled for the first 20 minutes of the run (auto-fallback to smaller model if errors spike).
- Continuous batch sizing will be adjusted to maintain tail-latency SLOs; I'll bring the pre-tuned batch profile.
- Monica: please validate the KV cache warm-up script is included in the runbook (redwood-runbook-20270409.md).

I can be on the call Apr 8 to own rollbacks and cluster scaling.

—Marcus
Director, Platform Reliability
From: Calyx Health Infra <infra@calyxhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling verification — run results (summary)

Team,

We executed the run this morning (attached: load-results-20270408.csv) following the plan. High-level summary: 
- Sustained throughput: 3,120 tokens/sec for a 12-minute steady window (measured on our side).
- Peak bursts: reached 4,900 tokens/sec for 75s during the ramp phase.
- Latency: 95th percentile measured 430ms for requests <= 1k tokens; median 98ms.
- Errors: 0.18% observed (spike during aerobic ramp, auto-fallback executed and recovered).

Notes and asks for Redwood:
- We saw a steady increase in token generation cost on the second hour (likely due to longer caching warm-up than expected). Could you share the KV-warmup timeline you used?
- Please provide the Redwood-side Grafana snapshots and the canonical run log.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEFghiJKLmnop (contains raw CSVs + JMeter scripts).

—Liam on behalf of Calyx Infra
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@calyxhealth.com>, Calyx Health Infra <infra@calyxhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling verification and onboarding evidence — final items & acceptance next steps

Thanks Liam — and thanks to the Calyx infra team for running cleanly and sharing the artifacts. Summary and next steps from Redwood: 

Summary of acceptance: 
- Throughput target: validated (3,120 tokens/sec sustained > 3k requirement).
- Burst tolerance: 4.9k peak reproduced (within expected window).
- Latency: 95th = 430ms (< 450ms target).
- Error budget: within threshold (0.18% < 0.5%); auto-fallback behaved as designed.

Deliverables we will upload by EOD Apr 13: 
- Redwood Grafana snapshots and canonical run log (redwood-runbook-20270409.md attached).
- KV warm-up timeline and recommended warm-up command (short script).
- A brief acceptance note you can attach to your procurement folder if needed.

Action items and owners: 
1) Redwood (Monica): upload run logs + Grafana links to the Drive (due Apr 13).
2) Calyx (Liam): sign off on acceptance note and confirm you want Dedicated pool provisioned (reply here).
3) Redwood (Marcus): schedule the Dedicated pool provisioning once sign-off is confirmed; estimate 2 business days to reserve capacity.

If Calyx signs off here, we'll transition this thread into the onboarding / provisioning checklist and loop in CSM for post-provisioning run validation.

Thanks — nice run everyone, good to see the fallback path exercise.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
